sequence.description: Which emails they get: vata, pitta, kapha, vata-pitta, vata-kapha, pitta-kapha or tridoshic.

status.description: Set to unsubscribed to stop their emails. Set back to active to resume.

nextStep.description: The next email to send (1 to 5). 6 means all five were sent.

startedAt.description: When they took the quiz. Each email goes out a set number of days after this.
